subject: Advocate onboarding: short testimonial + review ask
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@syncwave.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Advocate onboarding: short testimonial + review ask

Hi Sophie —

Hope you’re well. Quick thank-you again for the thoughtful feedback during onboarding — the SyncWave team’s notes were really helpful for our runtime tuning work.

We’re putting together a short advocate program (super low lift) and I wanted to check whether someone on your side would be open to either:

- A 15-minute recorded call to capture a brief technical testimonial we can quote in a case snapshot, or
- A 2–3 paragraph written quote that we can attribute to SyncWave for a one-page highlight.

If you’re up for it, we’ll also post a short review on G2 or TrustRadius and can provide a $100 e-gift (or equivalent) as a thank-you. We’ll handle fulfillment — no procurement process on our end beyond a name/email to send the e-gift to.

I attached a one-page case brief and a two-column list of suggested talking points to make it painless. If helpful, here’s a 15-minute scheduling link: https://cal.redwood.ai/marcus/15min

If a written quote is easier, feel free to reply inline — two short paragraphs is perfect. If you’re open to the call, recommend a couple of times and I’ll book.

Thanks again — appreciate the partnership.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Customer Advocate, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

A few quick notes: our procurement team sometimes requires a short exception for promotional credits/gift cards. I can check, but it may add a couple of days. Is there any timeline for when you need the quote published?

Otherwise I can either:
- Send a 2–3 paragraph written quote from me by next Wednesday (Aug 4), or
- Do the 15-minute call on Aug 2 between 11:00–11:30am BST (that’s 06:00–06:30 PT) if that still works for you.

If we go with the e-gift, can you confirm whether it’s delivered to an email address or to a corporate PO? Also, please send the exact wording you need for attribution (title/company).

Great — thanks for the fast reply, Sophie. All sounds good and flexible on our side.

Timeline: no hard deadline — publish whenever makes sense for SyncWave. If you can do Aug 4 written quote that’s perfect. If you prefer the 15-minute conversation, Aug 2 at 11:00 BST works for me; I’ll take the earlier slot on my calendar if you confirm.

E-gift logistics: we deliver a digital card via email (Tango/Bonusly style). We just need the recipient name and the email to send it to. If procurement needs a short note, we can provide a one-line payment justification — I can copy that below.

Attribution: please use “Sophie Turner, Head of Product Ops, SyncWave” unless you prefer an alternate.

Monica — quick favor: can you own fulfillment if Sophie confirms (send the e-gift and add the quote to HS-83021)? Also drop the one-liner justification for procurement below.

Suggested one-line justification for procurement: "Promotional appreciation for customer advocacy; $100 e-gift to participant contingent on short testimonial or written quote."

Suggested short prompts (attached as plain text) if Sophie wants to do written:
- What was the task/setup that made Redwood a fit?
- One measurable outcome (latency/cost/throughput) or anecdotal improvement
- A sentence on reliability/support experience

If you’d like a template reply to paste into internal comms, say the word and I’ll send.

—Marcus
